m3ae_g_after_tensor_contract_fix.input_contract: RawFrameClipDataset consumed rgb_regions via rgb_regions_grid_v1 with no rgb_frames fallback.

prediction_collapse.summary: Predictions remain concentrated on please and hat rather than fitting all five train labels.

contact_sheet_observations.inspection_method: Manual visual review of the retained PNG contact sheets in docs/validation/return-to-form-tier0-remediation-contact-sheets.

by_label.observation: Head, face, and forehead-contact motion are visible across sampled train, validation, and test rows. Some fast hand motion is blurred, but no systematic head or hand crop cut-off is visible in the retained sheet.
Head and forehead-area motion are visible across sampled rows. Several samples include hats/caps and signer variation, but the retained sheet does not show a concrete fixed-crop truncation pattern.
Head/top-of-head and hand-to-head motion are visible. A few frames place the hand near the upper image edge, but the sign is still visible and not systematically cropped out in the sampled sheet.
Chest and hand motion are visible in sampled rows. This label retains the strongest recall and does not show a crop-specific blocker.
Chest-level horizontal hand motion is visible in sampled rows. Validation recall drops to zero after the corrected-input rerun, but the retained sheet does not show systematic hand truncation.

contact_sheet_observations.limitation: The retained M3AE-R contact sheets were generated while diagnosing the pre-fix rgb_frames compatibility slice. They are useful for checking obvious source/crop visibility, but they do not by themselves visualize the final rgb_regions_grid_v1 tensor layout consumed by M3AE-G.

fixed_crop_and_region_assessment.crop_config_observation: The fixed-crop config includes dedicated left-hand, right-hand, upper-body, head, and full-frame regions. It explicitly anticipated that dad, grandpa, and hat could expose head-region confusion.

region_adapter_risk.risk: rgb_regions_grid_v1 tiles five 96x96 crops into a 192x288 RGB grid, then prepare_frames resizes the whole grid to 96x96 for the compact 3D model.
region_adapter_risk.effect: Each original crop is effectively compressed inside the final 96x96 image, and the compact model sees region tiles as a single ordinary RGB image rather than as named regions or separate branches.
region_adapter_risk.classification: model/architecture input-adapter bottleneck rather than a proven fixed-crop coordinate failure

observations: The failed rerun is a smoke budget, not a capacity proof: max_train_batches=8 exposes only 64 of 125 train examples per epoch.
The compact 3D model applies strided spatial/temporal convolutions and global adaptive pooling to an ordinary 96x96 RGB input.
The current corrected-input adapter loses explicit region identity after tiling and global resizing.
No augmentation was used, and the checkpoint was selected by capped validation accuracy rather than by terminal train fit.
model_architecture_and_training_config_a.plausible_bottleneck: The current smoke combines an aggressive region-grid downsample, compact global-pooled architecture, capped train batches, no augmentation, and best-validation checkpointing; this is now more plausible than a gross tensor or source/crop visibility failure.

label_and_split_assessment.assessment: Signer/source split generalization may still matter, but the immediate blocker is not held-out generalization because the model also fails train sanity on the five-label train set.

blocker_classification.why_not_crop_region_remediation: Manual contact-sheet review did not find a concrete systematic crop cut-off or missing head/hand region in the sampled evidence.
blocker_classification.why_not_label_or_split_remediation: The selected labels have usable clip and signer counts, and train recall still fails, so split/held-out generalization is not the first blocker.
blocker_classification.why_not_handboxnet_ablation_planning: No crop-quality-bounded failure was proven that would justify making HandBoxNet active.
blocker_classification.why_not_stop_reduced_claim: There is still a bounded, no-new-source, no-label-expansion diagnostic that can isolate whether the compact model/input adapter/budget can fit the existing train set.

next_action.description: Run a bounded no-label-expansion microprobe that isolates the train-fit bottleneck: keep the same Tier 0 manifests and approved PopSign tensors, no new media or source approvals, and compare a minimally changed input/model/training configuration against the current compact rgb_regions_grid_v1 smoke before any label expansion.

non_actions: No training was run in this triage slice.
No controlled clip-heldout checkpoint was evaluated.
No source was approved and no media was imported.
No ONNX export or model-card promotion was performed.
No Brev worker was created or stopped.
